Body.Content:
Geo-replication will enable Container Registry to function as a single registry while being available for local operations in the replicated regions. As images are used across many Azure services, you will be able to benefit from a single management plane while maintaining network-close, fast, and reliable image pulls.

Read about geo-replication preview, and Azure Container Registry managed SKUs.
